Four full-length 16S records copied verbatim from RDP 19 (the cleaned
full-length training FASTA, IDs as there; RDP trainset Zenodo
10.5281/zenodo.14168771). Used by `tests/test_insilico_pcr.py` for the V4-V5
(515F-Y/926R) in-silico PCR known-answer cases. The Escherichia coli insert boundaries are checked against
E. coli 16S numbering (insert = positions 534 to 906, 373 nt).
